caseNameFull: Harris, Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare v. McRae

opinions.text: D. C. E. D. N. Y. .[Probable jurisdiction noted, 444 U.S. 1069.] Motion of Alan Ernest to be appointed as counsel for children unborn and born alive denied. Motion of Legal Defense Fund for Unborn Children for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae denied.
